validate_environment_fp8_model: validate the GPU or XPU environment is compatible with FP8 quantization before loading a model
build_fp8_quantizer_instance: build a FineGrainedFP8HfQuantizer instance with a FineGrainedFP8Config for FP8 model quantization
replace_with_fp8_linear_layers: replace linear layers in a pretrained model with FP8Linear modules before weight loading
update_tp_plan_qwen3: update the tensor parallel plan for Qwen3 models with colwise and rowwise FP8 quantization patterns
get_weight_conversions_dequantize: get weight conversion operations to dequantize pre-trained FP8 weights back to bf16
